mesh.source: byte-identical to the frozen T4e fine level (T4e_IJ_f); build_t4f imports the FROZEN build_t4e.block_mesh_dict (build-time import, not on the grading path). The section-3 check must confirm blockMeshDict byte-identity against T4e_IJ_f/system/blockMeshDict.
mesh.why_one_mesh: PHYSICS, not economy. In T4d the coarse and medium meshes CLEARED C6.3 (1.4e-6, 3.39e-6) -- they went effectively STEADY; only the fine mesh sustained the unsteadiness. A c/m/f transient triple would compare a time-averaged unsteady fine field against near-steady coarse/medium fields, violating the smooth-refinement assumption a Roache triple/GCI rests on. So NO triple, NO GCI (CLAUDE.md rule 5): gate (2) is UNREACHABLE by registration, gate (1) binds in full. This is a validation-against-reference of the time-averaged field, gated but explicitly NOT GCI'd.

measurement.graded_quantity: peak(UMean profile)/U_bulk at r/D = 1, 2, 3 -- peak-of-the-mean, NOT mean-of-the-peak (the ERCOFTAC reference is the mean velocity profile).
measurement.reader_path: the FROZEN analyse_t4.sample_profile hard-codes fields (U). analyse_t4f makes a SCRATCH COPY at endTime, PROMOTES UMean into a field object named U (byte-copy with object renamed), then calls the frozen sample_profile / peak_of UNCHANGED. No frozen file is edited. This NEW reader path carries its own planted control (planted_controls[1]).
measurement.time_average: OpenFOAM fieldAverage FO over (U p_rgh T k omega), timeStart = T_init = 0.03 s, writing UMean etc.; the window is [T_init, T_end].

physical_time_budget.basis: D/U_bulk = 0.02/17.25 = 1.159e-3 s convective time; St ~ 0.5 -> shedding period ~ 2.32e-3 s. T_init 0.03 s ~ 26 D/U ~ 13 periods; window 0.05 s ~ 21 periods >= N_min 20. St ~ 0.5 basis to confirm at the section-3 review (open question 5); the calibration probe also sharpens T_init.
physical_time_budget.dt_regime: FIXED dt (adjustTimeStep OFF), chosen so endTime/deltaT is an exact integer -- keeps the rule-4 clause-5 generalisation exact/integer (see completion_rule_flag). Adaptive dt is REJECTED for the worse clause-5 form (open question 2).

S1_stationarity.criterion: measured stationarity onset t_stat <= T_init = 0.03 s (running-mean + running-variance on the instantaneous G-row peak series)

S2_window_adequacy.criterion: window [0.03, 0.08] holds >= N_min periods AND the running average of the windowed UMean-peak has converged (change over last 25% of window <= eps_avg)
S2_window_adequacy.period_measure: dominant frequency / detrended zero-crossing count of the instantaneous G-row peak series
S2_window_adequacy.steady_branch: if the signal is steady (no resolved unsteadiness -- a measured finding falsifying the premise, L1), the N_min clause is trivially satisfied and adequacy rests on running-mean convergence alone

S4_timestep_adequacy.part_i: committed fixed dt <= probe-measured CFL-limited dt at Co 0.9
S4_timestep_adequacy.part_ii: dt-halving SPOT CHECK on a short stationary sub-window (~2000 steps at dt/2) moves the time-averaged G-row peak by <= eps_dt
S4_timestep_adequacy.flag: a full dt-halving over the whole run would double cost; the spot-check form is registered instead

completion_rule_flag.fixed_dt_rationale: a fixed dt keeps the generalisation exact/integer; an adaptive dt would make the step count unknowable a priori and last==endTime a floating-point compare -- a WORSE clause-5 touch. Hence the design commits to fixed dt (open question 2).

S1/S2 suffice without it.

parallel_decomposition.decomposition_invariance_basis_CITED_not: ruling 19b7330a: the verdict is the peak of a statistically-converged TIME-AVERAGE; parallel and serial instantaneous trajectories diverge (FP reduction reordering, decomposition-dependent GAMG -- N-D12, N-D30) but the time-average over a statistically-stationary window is a property of the stationary statistics both layouts sample identically (ergodicity); the instantaneous divergence washes out. T4f's S1/S2 are the MEASURED backstop: S2 passing IS the measurement that the time-average is converged, and a converged time-average is decomposition-invariant to within the sampling tolerance (<=1e-3), far inside the 0.02 band. Recorded decomposition spread on graded quantities ~2e-5 to ~1e-4, all inside 1e-3.
parallel_decomposition.honest_limit_from_ruling: the lab has NO direct recorded measurement of decomposition-invariance for a time-averaged URANS statistic (all invariance evidence is steady; all dependence evidence is iteration-level). The grant rests on the ergodic argument + S1/S2 as the measured backstop, NOT on a serial-vs-parallel comparison.
parallel_decomposition.scope: admissibility only; scoped to T4f's single-grid time-averaged validation and like cases; does NOT touch the serial rule for grid-convergence (Roache-triple) ladders (F15's actual domain).

cost.basis: ESTIMATE, not measured. No measured buoyantBoussinesqPimpleFoam (or any URANS PIMPLE) rate exists in the T-family (all T4-lineage runs are steady SIMPLE; transient-conduction rungs solve only T, no pressure loop -- not a valid per-step basis). Built from T4d's OWN clean measured fine SIMPLE rate 1200.233 core-min / 64000 iters = 0.0187536 core-min/iter = 1.1252 core-s/iter on the identical 138240-cell mesh, scaled by a PIMPLE-step factor f_pimple. f_pimple AND dt are the two dominant uncertainties, flagged for calibration at completion (rule 12).

calibration_probe.purpose: MEASURE the CFL-limited dt on this mesh; the measured dt (rounded down to divide endTime evenly) becomes the committed fixed dt

dt_estimate_s.basis: wall-resolved cells 3-6e-6 m near r0/plate; tangential wall-jet velocity up to ~1.1 U_bulk ~ 19 m/s; Co set by flow-direction cell size at the worst cell. This is the calibration-probe target.

cost.cap_rule: the CAP row is the stall/overrun backstop; per rule 12 an overrun STOPS the run (capped=yes -> NOT A RESULT), no new budget. SERIAL timeout_s would be CAP core_min * 60 / 1; the PARALLEL run uses cost.parallel.timeout_s below.
cost.serial_scenarios_are_the_basis: the scenarios block above is the SERIAL compute basis (ranks 1). The OPERATIVE run is PARALLEL (ranks 8) -- see cost.parallel, which re-costs from these serial core-min via the parallel efficiency.

efficiency_eta.basis: ESTIMATE: 8-rank MPI PIMPLE on 138240 cells (~17280 cells/rank), 2.5deg-wedge (2D-like), simple geometric decomposition on a GRADED multi-block mesh -> some load imbalance. The supervisor's ~0.90 is the optimistic end. To be CALIBRATED (rule 12); the calibration probe can measure eta on a short parallel window.

parallel.core_min_rule: core_min_parallel = core_min_serial / eta (parallel adds comms + imbalance idle; core-min = wall_s * ranks / 60 rises ~1/eta). wall_h_parallel = core_h_serial / (nRanks * eta).

CAP.note: CAP uses the PESSIMISTIC eta 0.65 on the pessimistic-compute serial CAP 10507 core-min for headroom (10507/0.65).

parallel.timeout_s_basis: CAP core_min 16165 * 60 / nRanks 8 = 121238 s (~33.7 h wall). Stall backstop only; the operative stop is the endTime hard iteration cap or D1-style early logic (none here) -- an overrun STOPS the run (rule 12).
parallel.wall_time_win: POINT ~12.2 h (vs ~3.3 d serial); CAP ~33.7 h ~1.4 d (vs ~7.3 d serial). This wall-time reduction is the point of the grant.
parallel.dearest_single_run_parallel: CAP at pessimistic eta 0.65 = 16165 core-min = 269.4 core-h * $0.0513 = $13.82 << $25. Even the worst bracket stays under the per-run unit.

cost.dearest_single_run: PARALLEL CAP (pessimistic eta) = 16165 core-min = 269.4 core-h * $0.0513 = $13.82 << $25. (Serial CAP was $8.98; parallel raises core-min ~1/eta but the box-time bill stays under $25/run.)
cost.binding_constraint: with parallel granted, WALL TIME drops to ~12 h POINT / ~34 h CAP at 8 ranks -- still a capacity/scheduling call for the chief on the M6-contended 16 vCPU box (the run is HELD), but no longer multi-day. Dollars remain well under $25/run.
cost.rejected_3mesh_triple: coarse+medium+fine transient triple for a GCI ~ 1.33x fine POINT ~ 6200 core-min ~ $5.3 (still under $25/run) -- REJECTED on PHYSICS grounds, not cost: coarse/medium do not sustain the unsteadiness (mesh.why_one_mesh).
cost.usd_derived_not_measured: COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER sec 5: the box cannot read its own billing; dollars are derived at the owner-stated rate, reported-by-owner.
